raw_segments.text: Females, in fact, denied all political privileges, and not allowed, as married women, accepting
in criminal cases, a civil existence, have their attention naturally drawn from the interest
of the whole community to that of the minute parts, though the private duty of any member
of society must be very imperfectly performed, when not connected with the general good.
The mighty business of female life is to please, and restrained from entering into more important
concerns by political and civil oppression, sentiments become events, and reflection deepens
